slides.h1: Everything in One 'Prestige' Position? Meet Sun Bias.
slides.sub: Ego-driven concentration and the behavioural fix.

slides.body: This is a behaviour framework, not a prediction or a stock pick. No placement or dasha guarantees a financial outcome.
The Sun (planet of status and ego) can push towards a name-brand position that feels impressive. Concentration follows pride, not analysis.

slides.h2: How it can show in the chart
points: Sun in or aspecting the 2nd house
Context decides, none is a verdict alone

slides.body: One big position means one big point of failure. Being proud of a choice makes it harder to review honestly or to sell when facts change.
Set a position-size cap in advance, say a fixed share of your portfolio. Write the exit conditions down and review them on a set date.
The Sun also gives focus and conviction. The skill is separating conviction backed by research from pride. This is not a stock pick.
